description: This file contains utility functions related to opening files with specific flags and error handling, including a retry mechanism for interrupted system calls and handling the O_CLOEXEC flag support.

methods.name: int git_open_with_retry(const char * path,int flags,...)
methods.description: Attempts to open a file with retry logic on EINTR errors, with support for optional mode parameters when O_CREAT is specified.

methods.name: int git_open_cloexec(const char * name,int flags)
methods.description: Opens a file descriptor with O_CLOEXEC flag, with fallback if not supported, and additional logic to add FD_CLOEXEC via fcntl if necessary.
